# Krish Gupta — krishg.com

> Software engineer, poet, and founder building systems for people and for AI agents.

## About

Krish Gupta (Delhi / Bengaluru) programs since ~10, shipped Reseter.css by ~12 (~1.2k GitHub stars, 100k+ npm downloads), scaled HackTheMountains and PRUMUN, and founded [Ciel](https://withciel.com) in 2026. BSc Computer Science & Statistics at Christ University.
